Laila Patel: 🎉 Quick shoutout — EduStream signed an ISV listing with us on Azure Marketplace and committed to a pilot integrating Redwood Private for on-prem grading workloads at 3 school districts. Big win for the education vertical!
Marco Chen: Amazing! Was this the deal we were tracking from the proof-of-concept?
Laila Patel: Yep, same lead. They switched from an in-house LLM to Redwood Dedicated during POC and want private for data residency. Deal includes a co-marketing case study and a 12-month Dedicated commit for peak exam windows.
Anya Sokolov: Nice. Any special integration asks? Onboarding notes?
Laila Patel: They need SSO + SCIM, an automated snapshot/restore flow for offline grading clusters, and support for our on-prem installer in an air-gapped environment. Also asked about model quantization profiles to keep inference cost down during grading spikes.
Priya Desai: I'll own success/CS for the pilot. Can we get dedicated runbooks for the snapshot/restore and an admin training session? Also want a checklist for data handling and consent forms for districts.
Jordan Reyes: Legal flagged a few items: data processing addendum (DPA) updates for FERPA, and a tailored indemnity clause for school contracts. I can draft but need the list of third-party subprocessors and where backups live.
Anya Sokolov: From eng side — we'll add an installer variant for air-gapped deploy, and produce a quantization guidance doc (8-bit/4-bit tradeoffs). Need product to confirm SLOs for peak grading windows so we can capacity-plan the Dedicated pool.
Marco Chen: Sales notes: upsell path after successful pilot is Dedicated + 24/7 Premium Support + Optimize add-on. EduStream is excited about co-sell with Azure; marketing asked for a customer quote and a short one-pager for the Marketplace listing.
Laila Patel: Action items: @Anya can you slot the runbook + installer PR this sprint? @Jordan please share DPA template edits by EOD Thursday. @Priya schedule the customer kickoff and training for next Tuesday. Marco will coordinate case study assets with EduStream (they want a logo + 2 quotes).
Anya Sokolov: Got it — I'll open a PR and link the runbook in the drive.
Jordan Reyes: On it — will circulate redlines and a redlined DPA.
Priya Desai: Kicked off scheduling with EduStream — tentative kickoff Tuesday 10am PT. Invites coming.
deploy-bot: notice: marketplace-listing/edustream moved to staging — link: https://console.redwood.example/marketplace/edustream
Laila Patel: Thanks team — big cross-functional effort. If anyone needs intros to EduStream execs for the case study, DM me. :party_parrot:
Marco Chen: Huge win for the education playbook. Congrats all :tada:
